title: urophyllum ellipticum
intro: Urophyllum ellipticum, commonly known as Elliptical Urophyllum, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
